name: Audience / identity callout ("{Tribe}-aholics… this is for you 🥹")
status: STRONG externally (6.0M, 1.8M, 1.3M, 1.3M organic). Internally one moderate result: 'Calling ALL Christmas-aholics' 35.4K, with the best retention we measured (81%). The biggest untested family on our pages (external REPORT §4 #1).
summary: Name a tribe and hand them the product: hold it up to the camera like a gift made for the viewer, with a soft 🥹 tone. Identity is the share trigger, because people send it to the tribe member they know.
why: warmly.official 'Cold-aholics this is for you... 🥹💕' 6.0M / 74.4K shares: rolled pink robe held at chest (X).
jinglenap.official 'Dog MOMS... This is for you 👀🐶' 1.8M / 38K shares in 9.23 s; goth.robes 1.3M; nocturne.robes0 1.3M (X).
grumpyriderr 'Christmas HATERS... this is for YOU' 211K, with shares (1,808) above likes (1,619): a send-to-a-friend signal (V).
Internal: Merry Glows 'Calling ALL Christmas-aholics 😁' 35.4K, 3s 54%, avg watch 12 s = 81% (store FaceTime body). 'For my Christmas Lovers 🇺🇸🎄' did 5.9K on a tray, with no 'for you' reveal.

timing.basis: Hook copies the external held-reveal (goth.robes first cut 4.30 s, jinglenap 2.33 s); body = wearable master for robes. warmly 6.0M is ONE held shot to 11.17 s, kept as an experiment.

shots.content: talent holds the rolled/folded product at chest toward camera, soft smile; unrolls or lifts it by 2 s
talent slips the {product} on, turned away with her back to the phone, hood up so the hood design is what the phone sees
open it wide: white sherpa lining, step into the foot pouch (legs view); the B1→B2 boundary is the jump cut
macro: USB / power-bank clicks into the port in the fur
shots.text: JK flip lands exactly here on store hooks

shots.content: POV thumb presses the controller, LED heat levels climb
reclined on couch/bed, fully inside, hood up, eyes close / smile, tree lights behind; CUT MID-ACTION

rules: Product legible at 0 s, as in all four external winners.
Keep the house 66% activation / 84% payoff on FB until the long-shot experiment says otherwise.

text.style: House placement; ellipsis plus a 🥹/👀 emotional emoji.

variants.gate: Judge on avg-watch %; kill after 3 renders below page median.

variants.rule: 'Christmas HATERS... this is for YOU 😂' for Grinch-branded products, flipping to 'SAY "GRINCH" if you NEED this' on the activation cut.

checks.rule: hook matches /(for you|for YOU|this one's for)/

open: We have zero FB-native callout reels with the 'for you' reveal. Treat the first 3 renders as pure tests.
All 4 big external winners are older than 14 days, so they count half weight under the external freshness rule.
review: Tier B, not A: the only internal data point (35.4K) is below our winner bar. The external case is strong and the retention (81%) is the best we have.
